author: Adventure20685613755

title: We loved this...
text:
We loved this personalised experience & enjoyed seeing parts of Granada we would not have found on our own
Eduardo was a fantastic guide who gave us some options for the tour given the weather was extremely warm which was much appreciated
author: Michelle_B

title: Book This Tour!
text: Jennifer was an amazing guide! She was very knowledgeable and answered our many questions. The walk was not difficult for us, but could be challenging for anyone who may have some limitations due to the many stairs involved.  We learned a lot of interesting history and the three hours flew by!
author: E3792MSjohnm

title: Excellent experience
text: Marcel was extremely knowledgeable and gave us tons of interesting information about Granada’s long and diverse past. He also adapted the tour somewhat to skip things we’d already seen so that we could focus on what was new. A terrific tour!
author: Kirstin_O

title: Must do this tour while in Granada! Ask for Mirian.
text: This tour with Mirian gave us a comprehensive view into the cultures that make Granada a must visit city in Spain. The pace and activities were tailored to our interests and the use of the time was efficient but never rushed. Highly recommend this tour!
author: Debra_K

title: Wonderful private tour with Jenny of the Albaicin in Granada.
text:
We did this tour with Jenny.  She was amazing  - knowledgeable and answered all our questions. So many steps but worth it for all that we saw and learnt!  We learnt so much about the history of the area, especially regarding the churches, how mosques were taken over to be Christian churches.
Jenny gave us a great recommendation for lunch - a restaurant away from the main square.  We had a very short wait which was great after all the walking on the tour!
Matias from Yannat was great too  - great communication which we found very welcoming.
author: Climber25221643038

title: Granada is Great!
text: The in-depth walking tour of Granada was amazing. There was so much to see and so much to learn. Carlos was an informed, enthusiastic and generous tour guide.
author: GregandSue92

title: Going back in time in the best possible way!!
text: We thoroughly enjoyed our tour with Jennifer. She is friendly, extremely knowledgeable, enthusiastic and brought the experience of Albaicin to life for us, with her explanations. We went to the viewpoint of San Nicolas where we were able to see the Alhambra in all its glory! We walked by the river, saw the lovely street Paseo de los Tristes,  and many, many other significant sites.  The climb up the hill is quite a slog but is well worth the effort. We took a much easier route back down and Jennifer gave us her insider's knowledge of a great place for lunch!!! A fabulous tour in every way.
author: Climber25221643038

title: The cultural evolution of  Granada
text: This is an excellent opportunity to learn about the cultural evolution of Granada from centuries BC to the current times. Our tour guide, Rut, exceeded our expectations with her knowledge of Granada’s and her charm. We have taken many tours and this one is up there as one of the beast to date.
author: Joan_S

title: Wonderful afternoon!
text: We really enjoyed our private tour with JJ! He is from Granada and passionate about his city and seemed to really enjoy sharing it with us. We didn’t go inside any attractions, but we walked around many neighborhoods in the city, saw beautiful vistas, and were able to ask him questions about history and city life today. We saw where he went to primary school as well as some quieter streets and off-the-beaten path areas that we were very grateful to visit. Definitely a great way to be introduced to the city and highly recommended!
author: Amie_D
